Youth robotics & AI · Africa and North America

Every child deserves the chance to build the future.

AfroBot teaches young people to design, build and program robots and AI, in classrooms in Africa and communities across North America.

Our mission

We give children with limited access the tools, mentors and confidence to build the future with robotics and AI.

Programs

A pathway for every age

Children start where they are and grow with us, from their first hands-on build to leading a competition team.

DiscoverAges 6–9

Discover

First builds by hand. Children learn how machines move and work in small teams.

Explore Discover
BuildAges 9–12

Build

Larger builds, circuits and first code. Teams carry a project from idea to working robot.

Explore Build
InnovateCompeteAdvanceAges 13–17

Innovate · Compete · Advance

AI-powered humanoid robots, competition seasons, and older students mentoring younger teams.

Explore the teen track
Africa

Africa, since 2022

Started in Africa when conflict cut the school week to four days. Holiday programs have trained nearly 5,000 children.
